label: sync
definition: The verb that reads the board: cckit status --board lists the open issues by role with what is blocked, stale and in the merge queue, from GitHub. It writes nothing to GitHub. Agents read it first (--json) and decide from the data. The name is the verb's; renaming it is out of scope here.
is_not: A push or a pull: sync moves no code and no refs.
cckit status: status reads local work, open PRs and cleanup; sync reads the issues.
A refresh of the project's kit files: that is cckit init --upgrade.
